Business Overview:

ASL is a B2B technology-enabled company operating in the construction materials market. It utilizes a blend of technology and human expertise to simplify procurement process for purchasing bulk quantities of various construction materials which it provides real estate and infrastructure developers and contractors. The Co's services minimizes the need for intermediaries involved in the procurement ecosystem.
